title.purpose: Card titles, wordmark, and block headings.

body.purpose: Descriptions, hints, terminal output; prose capped at 65–75ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, buttons, chips, nav links.

micro.purpose: Legends, debug lines, notices, terminal summary.

status.purpose: Uppercase terminal state: READY / FIX FIELDS.

shadows.name: bleed
shadows.purpose: Paints a full-bleed band section; clipped horizontally so it never adds scroll width. Never elevation.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible treatment on controls. The only visible ring in the system.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Color and background transitions on buttons, chips, links.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: Control state changes and the install button reveal.

motion.name: toast
motion.purpose: The PWA update toast entering from the bottom.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: Refresh icon while an update is installing.

effects.name: paper-grid
effects.value: linear-gradient(to right, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 32px 32px;
effects.purpose: The 32px paper grid painted on html, never inside cards or the terminal.

effects.name: scrolled-header
effects.value: background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 80%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(24px);
effects.purpose: The header's only translucent state, applied after scroll.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled text input on a soft well; the configuration sheet's basic unit.

components.name: Chip (Selected)
components.description: A selected Sail service or package feature. ASCII [x] marks the state; the whole chip is the target.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;min-height:32px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid var(--primary,#b54424);border-radius:4px;background:var(--primary,#b54424);color:#fff;font:500 14px/1.4 'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out}.ds-chip .ds-mark{font-size:12px;opacity:.7}.ds-chip:hover{background:color-mix(in oklab,var(--primary,#b54424) 90%,#000)}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring,#171717) 50%,transparent);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Chip (Unselected)
components.description: An available service or feature. [ ] is the unchecked box; it never uses a chevron or icon.

components.name: Configuration Card
components.description: A sharp hairline block with a titled header and a 16px body. The build-sheet section.

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: The 56px sticky header: wordmark, three links, install and utility actions.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;height:56px;padding:0 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,rgba(15,0,0,.12));background:var(--background,#fdfcfc);color:var(--foreground,#171717);font:400 14px/1.4 'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace}.ds-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:inherit;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}.ds-brand svg{height:1em;width:auto}.ds-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}.ds-link{padding:4px 8px;border-radius:4px;color:var(--muted-foreground,#646262);text-decoration:none;transition:background-color 150ms ease-out,color 150ms ease-out}.ds-link:hover{background:var(--accent,#eae8e8);color:var(--foreground,#171717)}.ds-link.is-active{color:var(--foreground,#171717);font-weight:600}.ds-nav-install{height:32px;padding:4px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(15,0,0,.12));border-radius:4px;background:var(--background,#fdfcfc);color:var(--foreground,#171717);font:500 14px/1.4 'Geist Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,monospace;cursor:pointer}.ds-nav-install:hover{background:var(--accent,#eae8e8)}.ds-nav-install:focus-visible{outline:3px solid color-mix(in oklab,var(--ring,#171717) 50%,transparent);outline-offset:1px}

components.name: Terminal Command Panel
components.description: The page's one dark moment: live command, ready/fix status, configuration summary, Copy. One per page.
components.html:
[ready]
$ curl -fsSL 'https://laravel-charter.test/application/build?name=new-laravel&services=none' | bash

# php 8.5 · react · pest · bun · boost

Run this in your terminal to scaffold your project with Laravel Sail.

narrative.overview:
Charter is a page from a build worksheet: warm paper with a faint 32px grid, every word in Geist Mono, configuration presented as a checklist of bracketed choices, and the finished command pasted at the top like the result of the calculation. The visitor is not reading a marketing page; they are filling in a sheet. The sheet should feel measured, legible, and already half-finished before they touch it.

The system's visual DNA is inherited from the captured opencode.ai terminal-native system that seeded this project: one monospaced face, cream canvas, hairline rules instead of shadows, [x] / [ ] markers instead of icons, and 4px corners on the few things you can click. Charter renames the accent to Solder Terracotta (#b54424), a fired-tool red rather than a brand blue, and turns the surface into a working build sheet rather than a marketing page. The command panel is the one inherited dark TUI moment, now doing real work as a live result rather than a mockup.

The result is a tool that looks like it was assembled by someone who builds things: flat, exact, and quietly opinionated. It carries no photography, no gradients, no decorative illustration, and no dark mode of its own beyond a straightforward inversion.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface for every role: Geist Mono, from the 30px page title to the 11px terminal status.
One accent: Solder Terracotta, used for the primary action and the selected state, almost nothing else.
One dark moment per page: the live command terminal. No other dark surface.
One column: configuration stacks; the finished command sits at the top, never in a sidebar.
One icon vocabulary: ASCII brackets ([x], [ ], [+], [−], $, #) before any SVG.
Flat on paper: 1px hairlines, square containers, 4px interactive corners, zero drop shadows.

rules.name: The Solder Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the action and the selected state, and nothing else. If it is not clickable or currently chosen, it does not get the accent; its scarcity is what makes the Copy button read as the next step.

rules.name: The One Dark Moment Rule
rules.body: A page may have exactly one near-black terminal surface. The command panel earns it; do not add a second dark card, a dark footer, or a dark hero.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono carries every role. Do not introduce a display face, a serif, or a sans body; a second family would read as a different product.

rules.name: The Build Sheet Rule
rules.body: Configuration is the checklist; the command is the computed result. Put the command at the top of the sheet, then the choices, never the other way round.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Pages use one content column. No sidebar, side panel, or sticky secondary column; a live result belongs inline at the top of the same column.

rules.name: The Menu Page Rule
rules.body: A page reachable from the header menu carries no "Back to…" link. Footer-only pages (Privacy, Terms, Stats, Glossary, Comparison) keep theirs.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If you reach for a shadow, reach for a hairline or a tone change instead.

rules.name: The Bracket Rule
rules.body: State is spelled in ASCII before it is drawn. Chips use [x] / [ ]; the package metadata disclosure uses [+] / [−]. Do not replace those markers with checkbox components, chevrons, or icon fonts. The FAQ is the one toggle that uses the accordion primitive's chevron rather than a bracket.

dos: Do keep every page to one column, with the live command at the top on both builders.
Do render all type in Geist Mono; build hierarchy from 30/18/16/14/12/11px sizes and 700/600/500/400 weights.
Do use Solder Terracotta only for the primary action and the selected state.
Do keep the logo mark in its own Logo Orange (#f15a30); it is not the UI accent.
Do use [x] / [ ] for chip state and [+] / [−] for disclosure; keep them as text.
Do separate with 1px hairlines and tone changes; containers stay square, controls 4px.
Do allow exactly one terminal panel per page, and let the command wrap in full.
Do keep a page that lives in the header menu free of back links.
Do show labels in human terms (Database, PostgreSQL) while the command keeps CLI values (--database=pgsql).
donts: Don't add a sidebar, second column, side panel, or sticky secondary column.
Don't put the command below the fields that change it, or reintroduce a "Command" heading; the panel and page title already say what it is.
Don't add drop shadows, gradients, glass, glow, or dark cards beyond the single terminal panel.
Don't use semantic colors (success/warning/danger) as page decoration or marketing accents.
Don't introduce a second typeface, italics, or a display serif.
Don't replace bracket markers with checkboxes, chevrons, or icon fonts.
Don't round containers; only interactive elements get 4px, and only the switch track is fully round.
Don't put a second dark surface on a page, or reuse the terminal panel for non-command content.
